commits.title: coopmwm: practice_starts option (B/R practice PPO starts from own cooperative bank snapshots)
coopmwm: practice_starts CPU tests + practice_wave role fix

head: c8fcfaee

what_it_does.summary: DEFAULT OFF. For B-v2v and R-v2v a registered fraction (practice_fraction, proposal 0.25 => 6 of the 24 PPO episodes of one update) of each update's PPO episodes start from snapshots of the arm's OWN admitted within-seed cooperative bank examples instead of fresh t=300 starts. A-v2v is unchanged.
what_it_does.snapshot_and_seed: The episode is a restart of the example's decision snapshot through the REGISTERED sumo_verify.VerifyController ('policy continues' branch semantics): exact prefix replay with the sealed prefix fingerprint check, the snapshot's own t0 command, CRN generator restore at t0 (seed-1 examples: the stored snapshot generator state; seed-2 examples: replay_bank.replicate(snapshot, verification_id) - exactly the seed-2 CRN the example's own branches ran with), committed snapshot plans continue, no new plan is ever proposed.
what_it_does.policy_from_t0: CAVs are controlled by the CURRENT training policy from t0 (the job carries the same weights the update's normal episodes carry; v2v/intent observation wrappers apply exactly as in every other v2v controller). PPO/viability/routing see only the strictly post-t0 seconds (practice_starts.strip_steps): the replayed prefix seconds (<= t0, including the snapshot's t0 command) carry recorded behaviour-policy data and never become training steps.
what_it_does.horizon_reward_charge: Normal 1200 s horizon stop and normal per-second team-J reward; every practice episode is charged sim_s=1200 in the SAME phase (v2v_train) through the SAME hooks as normal episodes (reserve -> admission -> episode -> failure replacement). A failed practice episode is replaced by a normal fresh start in the same cell (accel_runner.replacement_job strips the snapshot state).
what_it_does.sampling: Uniform over the eligible examples with a per-example repeat cap per update (practice_repeat_cap, registered values 1 or 2); deterministic RNG digest(practice=plan|arm|update|training_seed|fraction|cap). The sampled plan is sealed once (replay_bank/<ARM>/PRACTICE_PLAN_<ARM>_<UUU>.json, practice_plan_sha256) and FROZEN: process restarts reuse the same rows/job ids and never re-sample even if the bank grows.
what_it_does.r_fallback: Documented: when R has fewer cooperative examples than the fraction requires, the remaining practice starts come from R's OTHER ADMITTED examples (rows flagged fallback=true); the practice count is always B's count; B never falls back.
what_it_does.empty_bank: Empty or unresolvable bank (BankDataMissing) -> plan with zero rows -> a full normal 24-episode wave. Bank examples are the arm's own-bank decisions only (own replay_bank links; imported u3 labels are never practice starts).
what_it_does.receipts_and_report: Each practice episode RESULT.json carries a practice block (practice=true, verification_id, example_id, seed_index, t0, snapshot_sha256, CRN provenance, fallback, charged_sim_s; never the snapshot itself). The per-update receipt <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json gains a 'practice' block ONLY when the option is ON: practice vs normal episode counts, distinct examples used with repeat counts, mean returns vs normal (per episode and per control second), per-episode rows.
what_it_does.per_update_sim_s_rule: 24 PPO episodes per update as before; k practice episodes replace the last k worlds of batch_worlds(u) and charge the same 1200 sim_s each in v2v_train, so the per-update charge is identical (delta = 0 sim-s).

practice_starts.arms: B and R equal; A unchanged

practice_fraction.meaning: fraction of the update's 24 PPO episodes that start from snapshots (0.25 => 6)

practice_repeat_cap.meaning: max times one example may be used per update

keys.equality_rule: One key set serves B and R (optional cfg['practice_starts_by_arm'] accepted only when B == R == the values); bind_runtime refuses mismatch and unregistered values

wiring.v2v_launch3: BANK_OPTIONS carries the registered launch defaults (practice_starts=False, 0.25, cap 2); PRACTICE_KEYS/PRACTICE_FRACTIONS/PRACTICE_REPEAT_CAPS; practice_options_for(cfg, arm) validates B == R, OFF or registered ON, refuses A; bind_runtime validates (never pins) the practice keys so a later runtime may enable at an update boundary
wiring.prepare_intent: v2v_runner.prepare_intent(practice_starts=False, practice_fraction=None, practice_repeat_cap=None) - defaults produce the OFF launch config; ON differs from OFF in the single practice_starts key; producer refuses unregistered values
wiring.v2v_live: hooks() validates practice_options_for for B and R at hook time; scheduling lives in v2v_runner
wiring.v2v_runner: run_arm's train wave wrapper: when enabled, plan_for_update (frozen) -> original_wave for the remaining worlds -> one original_wave call per practice episode (practice_starts.wave_call builds ident/worlds/extras: snapshot branch prefix, snapshot runtime/checkpoint/noise, sim_s=1200) -> results merged and pre-t0 steps stripped
wiring.warm_runner: run_arm writes the per-update 'practice' report into <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json only when b['practice_starts'] is set and the arm has a bank
wiring.accel_plant: episode(): jobs with a 'practice' key restart through the registered VerifyController (+ the v2v observation wrapper for v2v jobs) and flag the receipt; jobs without the key are untouched
wiring.accel_runner: replacement_job(): a failed practice job is replaced by a normal fresh start (practice/branch/samples keys stripped)

how_to_enable_at_an_update_boundary: 1. Let the running V2V arms finish update k and pause at the boundary (WARM_<ARM>_PAUSED.json / resume_update=k as for any resume).

2. Produce the new runtime config: v2v_runner.prepare_intent(base, root=..., legacy_root=..., source_root=..., common_checkpoint_sha256=..., practice_starts=True) - practice_fraction/practice_repeat_cap default to the registered 0.25/2; B and R keys are identical by construction.

3. Re-register the launch identity for the new V2V_RUNTIME.json: the launch3 gate/binding flow (gate PASS for the exact deployed commit, runtime_sha256 in a new additive LAUNCH3 binding, check_hold) exactly as at first launch; v2v_launch3.bind_runtime validates the ON values (B == R, registered fraction/cap) instead of pinning them.

4. Re-run the launch3 preflight and re-dispatch the train children with resume_update=k (v2v_live.spawn('train', arm)); the first update each B/R child trains is update k+1 and its practice plan freezes at that boundary (replay_bank/<ARM>/PRACTICE_PLAN_<ARM>_<k+1:03>.json).

5. Verify per update in <ARM>_UPDATE_<UUU>.json['practice'] (practice/normal counts, examples, returns vs normal) and the per-episode receipt flags in jobs/<id>/RESULT.json['practice']. Turning it OFF again repeats the same steps with practice_starts=False; plans already frozen stay on disk as history.
Charge note: enabling does not change the per-update charge (6 practice episodes replace 6 normal episodes at the same 1200 sim_s in v2v_train; delta 0).
